MALACAÑANG
PRESIDENTIAL DECREE No. 337
GRANTING LONGEVITY PAY TO CIVILIAN INVESTIGATION AGENTS OF THE CRIMINAL
INVESTIGATION SERVICE, PHILIPPINE CONSTABULARY, AND TO CIVILIAN INTELLIGENCE
AGENTS OF THE INTELLIGENCE SERVICE/UNITS OF THE ARMED FORCESOF THE PHILIPPINES
WHEREAS, martial law has been declared under Proclamation No. 1081, dated September 21, 1972, and is
now in force and effect:
WHEREAS, the Armed Forces of the Philippines more than any agency of the government, has been charged
to carry a greater share of the burden of suppressing all forms of lawlessness, violence and subversion as well
as any act of insurrection or rebellion, to pave the way for the institution of much-needed reforms in our
WHEREAS, the civilian investigation agents of the Criminal Investigation Service, Philippine Constabulary
and the civilian intelligence agents of the Intelligence Service/Units of the Armed Forces of the Philippines,
have participated and played an important role in the suppression of criminality and other forms of
lawlessness, and in the detention, identification and arrest of leaders of communist organizations/movements,
lawless armed groups and crime syndicates;
WHEREAS, the civilian investigation agents of the Criminal Investigation Service, Philippine Constabulary,
and the civilian intelligence agents of the Intelligence Service Units of the Armed Force of the Philippines are
exposed to the same danger as their military counterparts in the performance of hazardous missions;
WHEREAS, it is imperative to raise the efficiency and morale of the civilian investigation agents of the
Philippine Constabulary and the civilian intelligence agents of the Armed Forces of the Philippines in
consonance with the policy of the government to inculcate professionalism in the service;
NOW, THEREFORE, I, FERDINAND E. MARCOS, President of the Philippines, by virtue of the powers
vested in me by the Constitution as Commander-in-Chief of all the Armed Forces of the Philippines, and
pursuant to Proclamation No. 1081, dated September 21, 1972, and General Order No. 1 dated September 22,
1972, do hereby order and decree that henceforth:
1. Civilian investigation agents of the Criminal Investigation Service, Philippine Constabulary, whose powers
and duties are defined under Republic Act Numbered five thousand seven hundred fifty, and civilian
intelligence agents of the Intelligence Service/Units, Armed Forces of the Philippines shall receive, in addition
to their basic monthly salary, longevity pay equivalent to ten per centum of their latest monthly salary for
every five years of continuous service with the Criminal Investigation Service and the Intelligence
Service/Units, as the case may be: Provided, That in the determination of their length of service for purposes
of this Decree, only uninterrupted and continuous service with the Criminal Investigation Service or
Intelligence Service/Units, as military or civilian intelligence agents shall be considered: Provided, further,
That the longevity pay of the civilian investigation agents and the civilian intelligence agents shall not exceed
fifty per centum of their basic salary.
2. Such sums as may be necessary to implement this Decree is hereby appropriated out of the savings of the
Department of National Defense. Thereafter, the sum necessary for the purpose shall be included in the
General Appropriations Act.
This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 21th day of November, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-three.
